subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the Green Revolution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mining**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Green Revolution primarily focused on increasing agricultural productivity through the use of modern technology and methods.
 
• Fertilizers were extensively used to enhance soil fertility and increase crop yields.
 
• Pesticides were employed to protect crops from pests and diseases, ensuring healthier and more abundant harvests.
 
• High-Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds were introduced to farmers to produce more output per unit of land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fertilisers:**

 
 
• Fertilizers are chemical or natural substances added to soil to increase its fertility and support plant growth.
 
• They are rich in essential nutrients like nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, which are vital for plant development.
 
• The use of fertilizers during the Green Revolution significantly boosted crop yields and food production.
 
 
 
• **Pesticides:**
 
 
• Pesticides are substances used to prevent, destroy, repel, or mitigate pests that can harm crops.
 
• They include insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and rodenticides.
 
• During the Green Revolution, the use of pesticides helped protect crops from various pests and diseases, contributing to higher agricultural productivity.
 
 
 
• **HYV Seeds:**
 
 
• High-Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds are genetically enhanced seeds designed to produce more output per unit of land.
 
• These seeds have a higher resistance to diseases and pests and are more responsive to fertilizers.
 
• The introduction of HYV seeds during the Green Revolution played a crucial role in increasing food production, especially in developing countries.
 
 
 
• **Mining:**
 
 
• Mining involves the extraction of valuable minerals or other geological materials from the Earth.
 
• It is not related to agricultural practices and was not a component of the Green Revolution.
 
• The Green Revolution focused on agricultural advancements rather than mineral extraction.
